title: Dowry Ring
summary: Give the ring to Benryn to complete Rescue the Trapped Man. If Benryn has not told you about it, the haystack needs a DC 15 Perception check to reveal the chest.

fields.Use: Give the ring to Benryn to complete Rescue the Trapped Man. If Benryn has not told you about it, the haystack needs a DC 15 Perception check to reveal the chest.
